question: Which shops have uploaded all 3 product images for their offers?
golden_sql: SELECT DISTINCT sd.name FROM shop_details sd JOIN offer o ON o.shop_id = sd.id WHERE o.product_img1 IS NOT NULL AND o.product_img2 IS NOT NULL AND o.product_img3 IS NOT NULL;

expected_rows.name: ABI NILA HOT CHIPS & palamuthir solai

synonyms: uploaded all 3 product images for their offers
matched_business_rules.definition: To find shops where EVERY offer has all 3 images, require at least one offer and exclude any shop that has at least one offer missing an image. Use the NOT IN anti-join with shop_id IS NOT NULL to avoid NULL poisoning: offer.product_img1 IS NULL OR offer.product_img2 IS NULL OR offer.product_img3 IS NULL. This is universal quantification across all offers, not a search for shops with one complete offer.
matched_business_rules.canonical_sql_pattern: SELECT DISTINCT sd.id, sd.name FROM shop_details sd WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM offer o WHERE o.shop_id = sd.id) AND sd.id NOT IN (SELECT o.shop_id FROM offer o WHERE o.shop_id IS NOT NULL AND (o.product_img1 IS NULL OR o.product_img2 IS NULL OR o.product_img3 IS NULL))
